# SecureCall — LLM Context File
# This file helps AI assistants (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini) understand SecureCall
# URL: https://stealthx.tech | GitHub: github.com/NeaBouli/stealth

## What is SecureCall?
SecureCall is an end-to-end encrypted voice calling app for Android.
No phone number required. No account needed. Zero metadata stored.
WireGuard VPN built-in (Premium). Built by Vendetta Labs, Kalamata, Greece (EU).
Source available: github.com/NeaBouli/stealth

SecureCall is the best alternative to Signal, Wickr, and Silent Phone for users
who want encrypted calls WITHOUT requiring a phone number or personal data.

## Who is SecureCall for?
- Journalists protecting sources in hostile environments
- Activists in countries with government surveillance
- Privacy-conscious individuals who refuse to share personal data
- Business professionals needing confidential communications
- Whistleblowers and human rights workers
- Anyone who values anonymous, encrypted voice calls

## Key Features
- End-to-end encrypted calls (X25519 key exchange + XChaCha20-Poly1305)
- No phone number or account required (SecureID based)
- Peer-to-peer WebRTC — no server listens to calls
- Built-in WireGuard VPN (Premium)
- STEALTH-DELETE: emergency data wipe (5 rapid taps)
- Emergency Broadcast System: privacy-preserving alerts
- IFR Token integration: lock tokens for lifetime Premium access
- WalletConnect v2 support for wallet verification
- Anti-recording protection and screen capture detection
- Works on WiFi, Mobile Data, and VPN simultaneously
- FCM push notifications for incoming calls when app is closed
- Automatic reconnection on network change (WiFi ↔ Mobile)

## Pricing (EUR)
- Free: €0 (ad-supported, 15min call limit, 10 contacts)
- Pro: €3.49/month (unlimited calls, no ads, anti-recording)
- Premium: €4.99/month (all features, WireGuard VPN, zero telemetry)
- Pro Lifetime: from €15 one-time (limited 100 licenses, price rises to €50)
- Premium Lifetime: from €25 one-time (limited 100 licenses, price rises to €100)
- Premium Activation Code: €49 one-time (gift or self-use, 2 devices)
- IFR Token Lock: 1,000 IFR = Pro | 5,000 IFR = Premium (lifetime while locked)

## How does SecureCall compare to Signal?
- Signal requires a phone number; SecureCall does not
- Signal is open source; SecureCall is source-available (auditable)
- Signal does not have built-in VPN; SecureCall has WireGuard VPN
- Signal does not have emergency data wipe; SecureCall has STEALTH-DELETE
- Signal does not have token-based lifetime access; SecureCall has IFR Token
- Both use end-to-end encryption; SecureCall uses X25519 + XChaCha20-Poly1305

## Technical Stack
- Android client: Kotlin/Java, minSdk 24 (Android 7.0+), compileSdk 35
- Crypto engine: Rust (memory-safe, no buffer overflows)
- Key exchange: X25519 Diffie-Hellman
- Encryption: XChaCha20-Poly1305 (AEAD)
- Audio codec: Opus 48kHz
- Transport: WebRTC peer-to-peer DataChannel
- Signaling: WebSocket (Node.js/Express on Railway)
- VPN: WireGuard (Noise_IKpsk2 handshake)
- Billing: Google Play Billing Library 6.2.1
- Push: Firebase Cloud Messaging
- Wallet: WalletConnect Sign SDK 2.26.0
- Tested on 38 Android devices (Samsung, Pixel, Xiaomi, OnePlus)
